deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds a link claiming that the stained slice through a tumour illustrates explanting the tumour ('illustrates this'), whereas the lecturer only introduced the image to look at morphology and did not state that the slice illustrates explanting.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: often they will explant the tumor. Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this [FIGURE].

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: This was an off-hand remark by the lecturer about lecture logistics and was properly omitted as filler.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The word 'really' functions here as a colloquial intensifier rather than a scientific hedge, so omitting it does not constitute the removal of a hedge.

considerations.sourcePassage: with regard to the contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: The change from 'other things' to 'other components' is an acceptable stylistic rewording that preserves the original meaning.
